summary: First-party ATR/BPN BHUMI and the official Kabupaten Indramayu Satu Peta portal were verified as public land/geospatial custodial routes. Current public shells and the local catalog were readable, but no anonymous parcel geometry or stable parcel identity was retrieved; no sample is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Indonesian discovery queries and their actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-6324-indramayu.json.
requestOutcomes: BHUMI landing, map route, iframe and current console JavaScript were inspected. Satu Peta landing, OpenAPI schema, dataset catalog and mapset catalog were readable. The bounded Satu Peta geojson probe returned HTTP 422 with no geometry. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request or global TLS disable was used.
